messages:
ana: Heads-up — after yesterday's kernel rollout I'm seeing a sustained p99 tail spike on Mixtral MoE. throughput stable but tail doubled. suspecting router/top-k instability + KV cache churn. attaching notes.
perf-bot: flamegraph: https://perf.redwood/internal/fg/1969999999 (stack: router->dispatch->expert_exec, wide red band at router softmax) :eyes:
ana: repro trace: small burst traffic -> some experts get hot while others idle, then eviction churn. repro run: ./run_replay --trace=prod-1969-replay.json --model=mixtral-moex --warmup=500
ravi: can you paste current router config? top_k, softmax_scale, tie-break? also which kernel selection profile is live (triton/custom-kernel v2.3?)
ana: current live snippet: ```yaml
router:
  top_k: 2
  softmax_scale: 0.85
  deterministic_tiebreak: false
experts:
  parallelism: 1
  kv_cache_size: 256
batching:
  max_tokens: 2048
  adaptive_delay_ms: 3
```
sasha: we flipped kernel selection yesterday to custom-triton v2.3 for faster multi-head matmul. might have subtle fp32 numerics changes in softmax kernel. that could move logits closer together and make top-k brittle.
joel: profiler numbers: router logits stddev dropped from 0.42 -> 0.11, fraction of logits within 1e-2 of max went from 2% -> 18%. expert load imbalance ratio (max/avg) hit 6.2 in repro bursts. kv evictions/sec jumped ~3x.
maria: quick mitigation ideas: increase top_k to 4 temporarily, raise softmax_scale to 1.3, enable deterministic_tiebreak, and bump expert_parallelism to 2 for hot experts to absorb bursts. Also increase kv_cache_retention or size.
ravi: agree. ordering: 1) enable deterministic tie-break + softmax_scale=1.25 2) topo: top_k=3 3) if still bad, expert_parallelism=2. Also add a router metric for "near_ties_frac" (fraction of logits within 1e-3 of max).
ana: i'll land a canary patch with those 3 changes. quick config diff: ```diff
-router.softmax_scale: 0.85
+router.softmax_scale: 1.25
-router.top_k: 2
+router.top_k: 3
-router.deterministic_tiebreak: false
+router.deterministic_tiebreak: true
```
sasha: parallel work: i'll run kernel-level numeric check between old custom-triton and new to see if softmax rounding changed. will run nvprof / triton-metrics and small unit tests for softmax edge cases.
joel: added a microbench job: ci/perf/mixtral/replay-hot-pss that runs 10k requests with burst patterns, outputs p50/p95/p99 + expert_load_ratio + kv_evictions. queueing it now.
perf-bot: perf job queued: https://ci.redwood/jobs/mixture/mixtral-replay-1970001, expected ~45m.
maria: batching heuristics note — adaptive_delay_ms=3 seems to prefer larger batches which can amplify the hot-expert problem during bursts. try adaptive_delay_ms=1 to reduce long batching windows for bursty traffic.
ravi: also consider prefix/KV cache retention policy: make eviction LRU biased to keep last-used experts pinned for 2s after warm calls (config knob: kv_cache.pin_window_ms).
nana: changed canary to: softmax_scale=1.25, top_k=3, deterministic_tiebreak=true, kv_cache.pin_window_ms=2000, adaptive_delay_ms=1. will watch. canary scheduled in canary slot in 30m.
operator-bot: Canary deploy scheduled by ana at 2026-03-19T03:30:00Z. Target: mixtral-moex-pool-7. Rollback on p99>baseline*1.4 or error_rate>2x.
joel: after initial canary run: p50 ~ same, p95 down ~5%, p99 down ~18% on repro trace. expert_load_ratio improved to 2.1. kv_evictions/sec dropped by 60%.
sasha: kernel numeric diff shows small softmax delta in tail values but within tolerance; main driver was deterministic_tie_break + scaling.
maria: follow-ups: 1) add near_ties_frac gauge 2) add tie-break determinism to default config for Mixtral 3) test expert_parallelism auto-scale on hot-expert signals.
nana: filing follow-up tickets and will schedule perf-run under different RoPE scaling (head dim/rope scale) to ensure no regressions interact. thanks all :thumbsup:
perf-bot: ticket created AUT-1987: "Mixtral router tie-break & softmax scaling mitigation"
operator-bot: Canary succeeded and will be promoted on next stable window unless regressions observed. :rocket:
